tools.name: equity-analytics_financial-ratios
tools.description: Profitability, liquidity, leverage, efficiency and valuation ratios from caller-supplied statements and an optional price. Missing fields yield null metrics; division by zero is reported. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/equity-analytics/financial-ratios. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms

tools.name: equity-analytics_dcf-valuation
tools.description: Discount explicit free cash flows and a Gordon or exit-multiple terminal value to enterprise and equity value per share, with a discount-rate and growth sensitivity grid. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/equity-analytics/dcf-valuation. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: equity-analytics_wacc-calculate
tools.description: CAPM cost of equity and after-tax cost of debt combined into WACC from supplied equity and debt values. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/equity-analytics/wacc-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: equity-analytics_beta-regression
tools.description: Align asset and benchmark closes, compute simple returns at daily, weekly or monthly frequency, and return OLS beta, alpha, R², standard error and optional Blume-adjusted beta. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/equity-analytics/beta-regression. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not

tools.name: equity-analytics_corporate-action-adjust
tools.description: Apply split and cash-dividend factors backwards through a price series (CRSP-style multiplicative dividends) and return adjusted closes, volumes and cumulative factors. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/equity-analytics/corporate-action-adjust. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not

tools.name: equity-analytics_total-return-series
tools.description: Compound a total-return index from closes and cash dividends with optional withholding tax, and report price return, total return and CAGR. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/equity-analytics/total-return-series. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: equity-analytics_altman-z-score
tools.description: Compute the public manufacturing Z-score, private Z′ or non-manufacturing Z″ with published safe/grey/distress zones from caller-supplied balance-sheet and income items. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/equity-analytics/altman-z-score. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: equity-analytics_piotroski-f-score
tools.description: Nine binary profitability, leverage, liquidity and operating-efficiency tests from two years of statements. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/equity-analytics/piotroski-f-score. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: equity-analytics_beneish-m-score
tools.description: Compute DSRI, GMI, AQI, SGI, DEPI, SGAI, LVGI and TATA and the Beneish (1999) M-score with the −1.78 flag threshold. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/equity-analytics/beneish-m-score. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: equity-analytics_dupont-analysis
tools.description: Decompose ROE into net margin, asset turnover and equity multiplier, and optionally the five-step tax, interest and EBIT-margin path. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/equity-analytics/dupont-analysis. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: equity-analytics_peer-multiples
tools.description: Summarise peer EV/EBITDA, P/E and related multiples with optional IQR trimming, and imply enterprise, equity and per-share values for a target. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/equity-analytics/peer-multiples. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: equity-analytics_dividend-metrics
tools.description: Compute trailing yield, payout ratio, FCF coverage and DPS CAGR from a price and a dividends-per-share series. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/equity-analytics/dividend-metrics. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: equity-analytics_security-identifier-validate
tools.description: Detect identifier type by pattern, validate check digits, and optionally convert CUSIP or SEDOL to ISIN. Existence is not confirmed. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/equity-analytics/security-identifier-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: equity-analytics_lei-validate
tools.description: Check ISO 17442 structure and ISO/IEC 7064 MOD 97-10 check digits for a Legal Entity Identifier. Registration status is not looked up. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/equity-analytics/lei-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "equity-analytics" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: equity-analytics_security-identifier-validate, equity-analytics_lei-validate · Private data: equity-analytics_altman-z-score · Public sink: equity-analytics_financial-ratios, equity-analytics_dcf-valuation, equity-analytics_wacc-calculate, equity-analytics_beta-regression, equity-analytics_corporate-action-adjust, equity-analytics_total-return-series, equity-analytics_altman-z-score, equity-analytics_piotroski-f-score, equity-analytics_beneish-m-score, equity-analytics_dupont-analysis, equity-analytics_peer-multiples, equity-analytics_dividend-metrics, equity-analytics_security-identifier-validate, equity-analytics_lei-validate · Destructive: equity-analytics_financial-ratios, equity-analytics_dcf-valuation, equity-analytics_wacc-calculate, equity-analytics_beta-regression, equity-analytics_corporate-action-adjust, equity-analytics_total-return-series, equity-analytics_altman-z-score, equity-analytics_piotroski-f-score, equity-analytics_beneish-m-score, equity-analytics_dupont-analysis, equity-analytics_peer-multiples, equity-analytics_dividend-metrics, equity-analytics_security-identifier-validate, equity-analytics_lei-validate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: equity-analytics_security-identifier-validate, equity-analytics_lei-validate · Private data: equity-analytics_altman-z-score · Public sink: equity-analytics_financial-ratios, equity-analytics_dcf-valuation, equity-analytics_wacc-calculate, equity-analytics_beta-regression, equity-analytics_corporate-action-adjust, equity-analytics_total-return-series, equity-analytics_altman-z-score, equity-analytics_piotroski-f-score, equity-analytics_beneish-m-score, equity-analytics_dupont-analysis, equity-analytics_peer-multiples, equity-analytics_dividend-metrics, equity-analytics_security-identifier-validate, equity-analytics_lei-validate · Destructive: equity-analytics_financial-ratios, equity-analytics_dcf-valuation, equity-analytics_wacc-calculate, equity-analytics_beta-regression, equity-analytics_corporate-action-adjust, equity-analytics_total-return-series, equity-analytics_altman-z-score, equity-analytics_piotroski-f-score, equity-analytics_beneish-m-score, equity-analytics_dupont-analysis, equity-analytics_peer-multiples, equity-analytics_dividend-metrics, equity-analytics_security-identifier-validate, equity-analytics_lei-validate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
